name: Candles Scandinavia AB (publ)
summary: Candles Scandinavia AB (publ) specializes in the production and sale of aromatic candles, crafted from plant-based wax derived from rapeseed oil. The company not only offers its proprietary candle lines but also supplies products to various prominent private labels, including Yankee Candle, WoodWick, Blanche, Olivia & Co, Millefiori Milano, and Leyonore. Established in 2009, this Swedish enterprise operates from its base in Örebro.
